<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="vi"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,maximum-scale=1,user-scalable=no"><title>Space Invaders</title><style>
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}html,body{height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:#0a0f24;color:#fff;font:16px system-ui,sans-serif;touch-action:none;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none}
canvas{display:block;width:100%;height:100%}
#h{position:fixed;top:8px;left:0;right:0;text-align:center;font-weight:700;pointer-events:none;z-index:2;text-shadow:0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.8)}
#m{position:fixed;inset:0;background:#0a0f24ee;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:12px;padding:16px;text-align:center;z-index:3}
#g{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(48px,1fr));gap:8px;width:min(90vw,480px);max-height:50vh;overflow-y:auto;padding:6px;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.05);border-radius:10px}
button{background:#22c55e;color:#04210f;border:0;border-radius:8px;padding:10px 14px;font:inherit;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer}button:disabled{background:#26304f;color:#7d8bb5;cursor:not-allowed}
</style></head><body><canvas id="c"></canvas><div id="h"></div><div id="m"></div><script>
const C=c.getContext('2d'),N=60,K='mg_invaders',T='👾 Space Invaders',hint=matchMedia('(pointer:coarse)').matches?'Kéo ngón tay để di chuyển, tàu tự bắn khi chạm':'← → hoặc di chuột để di chuyển, Space hoặc giữ chuột để bắn';
let W,H,U,lv=1,run=0,best=1,lt=0,px=0;try{best=+localStorage[K]||1}catch(e){}
function rs(){W=c.width=innerWidth;H=c.height=innerHeight;U=Math.min(W,H*.8)*.08}onresize=rs;rs();
function menu(){run=0;m.style.display='flex';m.innerHTML=`<h2>${T}</h2><p>Chọn màn (${best}/${N})</p><div id="g"></div><p style="opacity:.7;max-width:90vw;font-size:0.9em">${hint}</p>`;const grid=document.getElementById('g');for(let i=1;i<=N;i++){const b=document.createElement('button');b.textContent=i;b.disabled=i>best;b.onclick=()=>go(i);grid.append(b)}}
function end(w){if(!run)return;run=0;if(w&&lv>=best&&best<N){best=lv+1;try{localStorage[K]=best}catch(e){}}m.style.display='flex';m.innerHTML=`<h2>${w?'🎉 Qua màn '+lv:'💥 Thua rồi'}</h2><div style="display:flex;gap:10px;"><button id="ba">${w&&lv<N?'Màn tiếp':'Chơi lại'}</button><button id="bm">Chọn màn</button></div>`;ba.onclick=()=>go(w&&lv<N?lv+1:lv);bm.onclick=menu}
function go(l){lv=l;m.style.display='none';rs();init();run=1;lt=performance.now()}
function loop(t){const d=Math.min((t-lt)/1000,.05);lt=t;if(run){upd(d);draw()}requestAnimationFrame(loop)}
let E,B,X,ed,sp,cd,lf,fr=0,ks={};
function init(){
  const r=Math.min(2+Math.floor(lv/7),8);
  const cl=Math.min(4+Math.floor(lv/5),12);
  U=Math.min(W/(cl*1.6+1),H/(r*1.8+6),42);
  E=[];
  for(let i=0;i<r;i++)for(let j=0;j<cl;j++)E.push({x:W/2+(j-(cl-1)/2)*U*1.5,y:H*.08+U+i*U*1.3});
  ed=1;
  sp=U*(1.5+lv*.12);
  B=[];X=[];cd=0;lf=3;px=W/2;
}
function hit(a){lf=a?0:lf-1;if(lf<=0)end(0)}
function upd(d){
  if(ks.ArrowLeft)px-=W*.8*d;
  if(ks.ArrowRight)px+=W*.8*d;
  px=Math.max(U/2,Math.min(W-U/2,px));
  cd-=d;
  if((fr||ks[' '])&&cd<=0){B.push({x:px,y:H-U*2});cd=Math.max(.15,.35-lv*.003)}
  let e=0;
  E.forEach(o=>{o.x+=ed*sp*d;if(o.x<U/2||o.x>W-U/2)e=1});
  if(e){ed*=-1;E.forEach(o=>{o.y+=U*.4;o.x+=ed*sp*d*1.5})}
  
  // Tần suất và số lượng đạn kẻ thù tăng theo màn chơi
  const spawnChance = d * (0.8 + lv * 0.15);
  if(E.length && Math.random() < spawnChance){
    const shotCount = Math.min(1 + Math.floor(lv / 12), 4);
    for(let k=0; k<shotCount; k++){
      const o=E[Math.floor(Math.random()*E.length)];
      X.push({x:o.x,y:o.y});
    }
  }
  
  B.forEach(b=>b.y-=H*.9*d);
  X.forEach(b=>b.y+=H*(0.35+lv*0.012)*d);
  
  B.forEach(b=>E.forEach(o=>{if(!b.d&&!o.d&&Math.abs(b.x-o.x)<U*.6&&Math.abs(b.y-o.y)<U*.6)b.d=o.d=1}));
  E=E.filter(o=>!o.d);
  B=B.filter(b=>!b.d&&b.y>0);
  
  X.forEach(b=>{if(Math.abs(b.x-px)<U*.5&&Math.abs(b.y-(H-U*1.5))<U*.6){b.d=1;hit()}});
  X=X.filter(b=>!b.d&&b.y<H);
  
  if(E.some(o=>o.y>H-U*2.5))hit(1);
  if(!E.length)end(1);
}
function draw(){
  C.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
  C.font=U+'px serif';
  C.textAlign='center';
  C.textBaseline='middle';
  E.forEach(o=>C.fillText('👾',o.x,o.y));
  C.fillText('🚀',px,H-U*1.5);
  C.fillStyle='#fde047';
  B.forEach(b=>C.fillRect(b.x-2,b.y,4,U*.5));
  C.fillStyle='#f87171';
  X.forEach(b=>C.fillRect(b.x-2,b.y,4,U*.5));
  h.textContent=`Màn ${lv}/${N} · ❤️ ${lf} · 👾 ${E.length}`;
}
onkeydown=e=>{ks[e.key]=1;if(e.key.startsWith('Arrow')||e.key==' ')e.preventDefault()};
onkeyup=e=>ks[e.key]=0;
c.onpointermove=e=>{if(run)px=e.clientX};
c.onpointerdown=e=>{px=e.clientX;fr=1};
onpointerup=onpointercancel=()=>fr=0;
menu();
requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script></body></html>
```[cite: 1]
